newsitem.title: TURKEY: 15 dead in Turkey's Kurd rebel conflict.
newsitem.headline: 15 dead in Turkey's Kurd rebel conflict.

text.p: Turkish forces killed 12 Kurdistan Workers Party guerrillas in a clash in the southeast of the country in which three pro-state village guards also died, security officials said on Saturday.
They said the clash took place on Friday on the Besta plateau in the mountainous province of Siirt.

More than 22,000 people have died in 12 years of fighting between troops and rebels seeking Kurdish autonomy or independence in the southeast. Tens of thousands of government-paid village guards, mostly Kurds, fight alongside regular forces.
